headline: Stlican Shelf Reignites as Coastal and Northern Fronts Shift Rapidly
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline dynamism has shifted sharply toward Stlican Shelf, where fighting has reignited around Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost with eight strategic base transitions recorded in the past two hours. Fisherman's Row and Nevish Line have likewise shaken off earlier lulls, logging fresh base handovers and accelerating casualties along disputed strongpoints including Tomb Father. Weathered Expanse continues to absorb punishing attrition, tallying nearly two thousand combined casualties over two hours as engagements persist across Frostmarch and Wightwalk. In contrast, strategic base exchanges in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County have paused during the latest interval, though both central sectors continue to register heavy casualties under persistent crossfire. Outlying rear and interior sectors remain largely dormant, leaving active territorial contention concentrated across the northern and maritime battlegrounds.
